title: Power and amplitude dB
prompt: Implement `db_power(p, p_ref)` and `db_amplitude(a, a_ref)` returning 10 log10 and 20 log10 ratios respectively.
test_source:
import math
import solution

def run():
    assert abs(solution.db_power(2.0,1.0)-10*math.log10(2))<1e-12
    assert abs(solution.db_amplitude(2.0,1.0)-20*math.log10(2))<1e-12
